# Generated by Native — do not edit. Manual additions go to project.cmake.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(emulator LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

file(GLOB_RECURSE NATIVE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp src/*.cc src/*.cxx src/*.c)
file(GLOB_RECURSE NATIVE_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS include/*.hpp include/*.hh include/*.hxx include/*.h)
add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} ${NATIVE_SOURCES} ${NATIVE_HEADERS})
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE include)

# Your own lines (libraries, flags, a different standard) live in project.cmake.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/project.cmake OPTIONAL)
